problems.title: Block on Incline - Basic
problems.statement: A block of mass m = 2 kg rests on a frictionless inclined plane at angle θ = 30°. Find the acceleration of the block down the incline.

problems.title: Block on Incline with Friction
problems.statement: A 5 kg block rests on an inclined plane at 37° with coefficient of friction μ = 0.3. Find if the block slides, and if so, its acceleration.

problems.title: Two Blocks with Pulley
problems.statement: Two blocks of masses m₁ = 3 kg and m₂ = 5 kg are connected by a massless string over a frictionless pulley. Find the acceleration and string tension.

problems.title: Block on Moving Wedge
problems.statement: A block of mass m rests on a wedge of mass M at angle θ. All surfaces are frictionless. What horizontal force F on the wedge keeps the block stationary relative to the wedge?

problems.title: Circular Motion on Banked Road
problems.statement: A car travels at 72 km/h on a banked road of radius 100 m. If the angle of banking is 30°, find the minimum coefficient of friction needed to prevent skidding.

problems.title: Block Sliding Down - Energy Method
problems.statement: A 2 kg block slides down a frictionless incline of height 5 m. Find its speed at the bottom using energy conservation.

problems.title: Spring Compression Problem
problems.statement: A 1 kg block moving at 4 m/s compresses a spring (k = 200 N/m) against a wall. Find the maximum compression.

problems.title: Block with Friction on Incline - Energy
problems.statement: A 3 kg block slides down a 10 m incline at 30° with μ = 0.2. Find the speed at the bottom using work-energy theorem.

problems.title: Loop-the-Loop
problems.statement: A ball starts from height h on a frictionless track and enters a vertical loop of radius R. Find the minimum h for the ball to complete the loop.

problems.title: Elastic Collision - 1D
problems.statement: A ball of mass 2 kg moving at 6 m/s collides elastically with a stationary ball of mass 4 kg. Find the velocities after collision.

problems.title: Disc Rolling Down Incline
problems.statement: A uniform disc of mass M and radius R rolls without slipping down an incline of angle 30°. Find the acceleration and the friction force.

problems.title: Angular Momentum Conservation
problems.statement: A spinning skater with arms extended has moment of inertia 4 kg⋅m² and rotates at 2 rad/s. When she pulls her arms in, I becomes 2 kg⋅m². Find her new angular velocity.

problems.title: Bead on Rotating Hoop
problems.statement: A bead of mass m is threaded on a frictionless circular hoop of radius R rotating at angular velocity ω about a vertical diameter. Find the equilibrium angle θ from the bottom.

problems.title: Projectile Motion - Basic
problems.statement: A ball is thrown at 20 m/s at 45° above horizontal. Find the maximum height and range. Take g = 10 m/s².

problems.title: Relative Motion - River Crossing
problems.statement: A boat can travel at 5 m/s in still water. The river flows at 3 m/s. Find the direction to row to cross the 100 m wide river in minimum time, and the drift.

problems.title: Two Bodies Motion - When Do They Meet?
problems.statement: A car starts from rest with acceleration 2 m/s². After 5 s, another car starts from the same point with acceleration 4 m/s². When and where do they meet?

problems.title: Satellite Orbital Velocity
problems.statement: A satellite orbits Earth at height h = R (where R is Earth's radius). Find its orbital velocity in terms of g and R.

problems.title: Escape Velocity Derivation
problems.statement: Derive the expression for escape velocity from Earth's surface using energy considerations. Calculate for R = 6400 km and g = 10 m/s².

problems.title: Simple Pendulum - Period
problems.statement: A simple pendulum of length 1 m oscillates with small amplitude. Find its time period. What happens if length is doubled?

problems.title: Spring-Mass Oscillation
problems.statement: A 2 kg mass attached to a spring (k = 200 N/m) is displaced 10 cm and released. Find the frequency, maximum velocity, and maximum acceleration.

problems.title: Sign Check - Incline Direction
problems.statement: A block slides DOWN a 30° incline. If positive is UP the incline, what is the sign of the acceleration component along the incline?

problems.title: Sin vs Cos - Quick Check
problems.statement: On a 37° incline, the component of weight PARALLEL to the incline is mg times: (a) sin 37° (b) cos 37°?

problems.title: Conservation Check - Friction Present
problems.statement: A block slides down a rough incline. Can you use mechanical energy conservation? Why or why not?

problems.title: Constraint Identification
problems.statement: Two blocks are connected by an inextensible string over a pulley. If block A moves down 5 cm, how much does block B move up?

problems.title: Frame Check - Pseudo Force
problems.statement: You're in a car accelerating forward at 3 m/s². In YOUR reference frame, what pseudo-force does a 2 kg object on the seat experience?

problems.title: Ideal Gas Expansion
problems.statement: An ideal gas expands isothermally from volume V to 2V at temperature 300 K. If initial pressure is 2 atm, find final pressure and work done (1 mole of gas).

problems.title: Adiabatic Process
problems.statement: One mole of an ideal gas (γ = 1.4) expands adiabatically from volume V to 2V. If initial temperature is 500 K, find the final temperature.

problems.title: Carnot Engine Efficiency
problems.statement: A Carnot engine operates between temperatures 600 K and 300 K. Calculate efficiency, and work output if 1000 J of heat is absorbed.

problems.title: Electric Field of Charged Ring
problems.statement: A uniformly charged ring of radius R and total charge Q lies in the xy-plane. Find the electric field at distance z along the axis. At what z is it maximum?

problems.title: Capacitor Network
problems.statement: Three capacitors of 2 μF, 4 μF, and 6 μF are connected: 2 μF in series with a parallel combination of 4 μF and 6 μF. Find equivalent capacitance.

problems.title: Wheatstone Bridge Balance
problems.statement: In a Wheatstone bridge, P = 100 Ω, Q = 200 Ω, R = 150 Ω. What value of S balances the bridge?

problems.title: Magnetic Force on Current Loop
problems.statement: A rectangular loop of 10 cm × 5 cm carries 2 A current in a uniform magnetic field of 0.5 T perpendicular to the loop. Find the torque on the loop.

problems.title: Lens Combination
problems.statement: Two thin lenses of focal lengths f₁ = 20 cm and f₂ = -30 cm are placed in contact. Find the equivalent focal length and power.

problems.title: Young's Double Slit
problems.statement: In YDSE, slit separation is 0.5 mm, screen distance is 1 m, and wavelength is 600 nm. Find fringe width and position of 3rd bright fringe.

problems.title: Photoelectric Effect
problems.statement: Light of wavelength 400 nm falls on a metal with work function 2.0 eV. Find the maximum kinetic energy of photoelectrons and stopping potential.

problems.title: Bohr Model Energy Levels
problems.statement: Using Bohr model, find the wavelength of photon emitted when electron in hydrogen transitions from n=3 to n=2.

problems.title: Unit Conversion Check
problems.statement: Convert 72 km/h to m/s. Quick!

problems.title: Vector vs Scalar - Work
problems.statement: A force F = 10 N acts on a block, displacing it 5 m at 60° to the force direction. Is work: (a) 50 J (b) 25 J (c) 25√3 J?
